results.summary_before: This project bridges a parallel AXI-Stream interface with a serial UART communication protocol. It converts data from the AXI-Stream bus to UART frames for transmission and vice versa. The design is useful for interfacing high-speed parallel data with serial communication links. results.summary: This project implements a 16-bit noise-shaping delta-sigma DAC in Verilog. It converts digital audio samples into a single digital output using delta-sigma modulation and pulse width modulation. The design can be driven by an RP2040 or RP2350 microcontroller and includes a built-in triangle wave generator for testing. It requires an external low-pass filter, such as the audio Pmod, to produce an analog audio signal.
